PreInvocation.command: [ -n "${WT_SESSION:-}" ] && [ -n "${WT_COM_CLSID:-}" ] && command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && WTA_HOOK_CWD="$PWD" WSLENV="${WSLENV:+$WSLENV:}WSL_DISTRO_NAME/w:WTA_HOOK_CWD/w" powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command 'try { if ($env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR) { & (Join-Path $env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR emit-hook.ps1) -CliSource antigravity -Event agent.prompt.submit } else { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source antigravity --event agent.prompt.submit } } catch { }; [Console]::Out.WriteLine("{}"); exit 0' || printf '{}\n'; exit 0

hooks.command: [ -n "${WT_SESSION:-}" ] && [ -n "${WT_COM_CLSID:-}" ] && command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && WTA_HOOK_CWD="$PWD" WSLENV="${WSLENV:+$WSLENV:}WSL_DISTRO_NAME/w:WTA_HOOK_CWD/w" powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command 'try { if ($env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR) { & (Join-Path $env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR emit-hook.ps1) -CliSource antigravity -Event agent.tool.starting } else { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source antigravity --event agent.tool.starting } } catch { }; [Console]::Out.WriteLine("{`"decision`":`"ask`"}"); exit 0' || printf '{"decision":"ask"}\n'; exit 0

Stop.command: [ -n "${WT_SESSION:-}" ] && [ -n "${WT_COM_CLSID:-}" ] && command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1 && WTA_HOOK_CWD="$PWD" WSLENV="${WSLENV:+$WSLENV:}WSL_DISTRO_NAME/w:WTA_HOOK_CWD/w" powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command 'try { if ($env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR) { & (Join-Path $env:WT_AGENT_HOOK_DIR emit-hook.ps1) -CliSource antigravity -Event agent.stop } else { wtcli.exe agent-hook --cli-source antigravity --event agent.stop } } catch { }; [Console]::Out.WriteLine("{}"); exit 0' || printf '{}\n'; exit 0
